verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Bridge's orchestration docs, which say a static template provides persistent deposit instructions that customers can reuse. That implies reusable deposit routes, but the docs never say they are per-customer or that incoming funds are automatically attributed for reconciliation. The core Stripe stablecoin docs cover checkout-style payments and Financial Account balances, with no mention of named virtual accounts or dedicated deposit addresses. Missing for 10: explicit per-customer dedicated deposit addresses or named virtual accounts, documented automatic attribution and reconciliation of incoming funds, coverage within Stripe's own stablecoin and Treasury products, independent or hands-on corroboration.
